name: job-hunt
description: Daily job search on LinkedIn and the careers sites of companies you watch, matched to your profile, with a tailored CV and cover letter for the best offers.

apify_token.title: Apify API token (optional)
apify_token.description: Free at apify.com, no card. The daily search then reads LinkedIn through Apify instead of your connection, and adds Welcome to the Jungle. Leave empty to skip.
